name: The Bell That Tolls for No One

rooms.name: Graveyard
rooms.description: Rows of crooked headstones stretch through the mist, several graves broken open from below, dark earth heaped beside empty holes. Something moved earth still clings to the nearest mound.

rooms.name: Church Porch
rooms.description: A shallow stone porch shelters under a pointed arch, its gargoyle spout chipped and grinning. The heavy church door stands half open, exhaling cold, candle-stale air.

rooms.name: Vestibule
rooms.description: A narrow entry hall smelling of wet wool and old incense. A stone font holds an inch of stagnant water, and prayer leaflets lie scattered like dead leaves across the floor.

rooms.name: Nave
rooms.description: The church's main hall rises into shadowed vaults, its pews overturned and shoved against one wall as if a crowd had fled in panic. Shards of colored glass from the high windows glitter in the dust, and something has dragged long smears through it.

rooms.name: Side Chapel
rooms.description: A cramped side chapel dedicated to some half-forgotten saint, its votive candles all extinguished. Scratch marks rake the inside of the doorway, as if something small and desperate tried to get in — or out.

rooms.name: Sanctuary
rooms.description: The raised chancel before the great altar is surprisingly intact — no dust here, as though something still keeps it. The tall windows overhead are dark, but the candle flames bend as if in a draft from nowhere.

rooms.name: Sacristy
rooms.description: A cluttered robing room where vestments hang like empty men along the wall. A trapdoor in the corner has been thrown back, revealing stone steps descending into darkness.

rooms.name: Office
rooms.description: The priest's study is a riot of scattered paper — ledgers, letters, and burial records fanned across the floor. The last entries in the open journal trail off into a single repeated line: the bell, the bell, the bell.

rooms.name: Rectory Bedroom
rooms.description: A narrow cell of a bedroom, the bed unmade and frozen mid-sleep, blankets trailing to the floor. Frost feathers the inside of the single window though the night is mild.

rooms.name: Bell Tower Stairwell
rooms.description: A tight spiral of stone steps climbs the tower wall into darkness, each tread worn into a dip by centuries of feet. From far above comes a slow, rhythmic creak — the pull and release of a bell rope.

rooms.name: Belfry
rooms.description: The open belfry at the tower's peak, where the great bell hangs black against the night sky. The rope is knotted around a figure-sized post, and the bell swings gently, tolling once — though no living hand is near it.

rooms.name: Cellar Stairs
rooms.description: Steep, uneven stone steps drop below the church, the walls sweating cold moisture. The air thickens with the smell of turned earth and something long dead.

rooms.name: Crypt Corridor
rooms.description: A low vaulted passage runs beneath the church, its walls set with empty burial niches whose stones have been pushed out from within. Drag marks score the dust in both directions.

rooms.name: Ossuary
rooms.description: A bone-store chamber where generations of the dead were stacked to make room for more — femurs in neat rows, skulls in pyramids. Several of the rows have collapsed as if something recently stood up out of them.

rooms.name: Crypt
rooms.description: The main burial vault of the church's founding families, sarcophagi ranked in rows under a sweating stone ceiling. Every lid has been shifted. Wet, gnawed bones are scattered in the corners, and the air carries a carrion reek.

rooms.name: Burial Chamber
rooms.description: A private vault off the corridor, its single sarcophagus carved with a knight in prayer. The ceiling above has cracked through, a wedge of fallen stone resting at an ominous angle, held by who knows what.

rooms.name: Sealed Tomb
rooms.description: The oldest vault in the crypt, its entrance arch bricked over once and recently burst outward from inside. The single stone coffin within is carved with the likeness of a sexton holding a bell rope — the founding Bell Keeper himself.

statBlock.name: Parishioner Zombie
statBlock.appearance: an elderly corpse in a threadbare black dress and mourning veil, fingers worn to bone, stringy grey hair hanging over a sunken face

statBlock.name: Chapel Skeleton
statBlock.appearance: a yellowed human skeleton in the tatters of an altar server's white robe, gripping a rusted shortsword, finger bones clicking as it moves

entities.name: Silvered Dagger in a Cloth Wrap

statBlock.name: The Bell Keeper
statBlock.appearance: a gaunt undead figure in the rotted black robes of a church sexton, skin drawn tight and grey over the skull, eyes burning cold blue, one hand fused around a corroded longsword, the other trailing the bell rope like a leash

entities.name: Rotten Floorboards — a sagging section of plank floor that gives way into a jagged drop

statBlock.name: Ossuary Skeleton
statBlock.appearance: a yellowed human skeleton patched together from mismatched bones, one arm slightly too long, clutching a pitted shortsword, jaw hanging open

statBlock.name: Crypt Ghoul
statBlock.appearance: a crouched, rubbery-limbed corpse with mottled grey flesh stretched over long bones, mouth too wide and full of broken teeth, gravecloth rags hanging from its hunched shoulders

entities.name: Unstable Ceiling — disturbing the fallen wedge brings the cracked roof slab down

statBlock.name: Ancient Zombie
statBlock.appearance: a desiccated corpse centuries old, skin like brown leather over bone, wrapped in the dust-stiffened rags of an antique sexton's robe, a corroded bell-puller's badge pinned to its chest

goals: Investigate why the church bell tolls at night with no ringer
Lay the restless dead of the graveyard and crypt to rest
Recover the consecrated silver chalice from the sanctuary
